purpose: Turn editorial decisions into behavior changes before the next draft reaches the Publishing Editor.
operatingRule: No lesson is complete until it changes a future draft, validator repair, lexicon choice, dossier weighting, or newsletter audience profile.

weakestPatterns.principle: Create headlines from the completed CE story dossier using actor + action + consequence.
weakestPatterns.teachWriter: Build the headline after the article/dossier is complete; do not rewrite from publisher headlines.

weakestPatterns.principle: Answer who, what, when, and where before context or analysis.
weakestPatterns.teachWriter: Answer who, what, when, and where before context or analysis.

weakestPatterns.principle: Attribute claims, separate confirmed facts from developing information, and qualify single-source details.
weakestPatterns.teachWriter: Attribute claims, separate confirmed facts from developing information, and qualify single-source details.

weakestPatterns.principle: Move from facts to context before analysis, without repeating the same sentence function.
weakestPatterns.teachWriter: Move from facts to context before analysis, without repeating the same sentence function.

weakestPatterns.principle: Start with the most newsworthy verified fact and reach the point within two sentences.
weakestPatterns.teachWriter: Start with the most newsworthy verified fact and reach the point within two sentences.

pass1Reporter.job: Produce only factual content from one clean event dossier.

pass2Journalist.job: Improve flow, transitions, pacing, and paragraph order without adding unsupported facts.

pass3Reader.job: Ask whether a first-time reader understands the lead, each paragraph earns its place, and repetition is removed.

preEditorRepairs.repetition: Remove repeated sentence functions before Publishing Editor review.
preEditorRepairs.transitions: Replace repeated stock bridges with story-specific context movement.
preEditorRepairs.headline: Generate headline from Story Dossier after body is stable, not from publisher headline.
preEditorRepairs.paragraphFlow: Reorder paragraphs as fact -> context -> consequence -> next step.
preEditorRepairs.attribution: Use evidence-specific verbs from Behavioral Lexicon.

nextBehaviorChange: Writer must read this engine before drafting and produce three internal passes before Publishing Editor review.
